description: This file implements a tracing system for a browser automation framework, managing trace recording, snapshot capturing, resource handling, and event logging within a browser context or API request context.

classes.name: Tracing
classes.description: A class managing trace recording, event logging, resource handling, and snapshot capturing for browser contexts or API request contexts.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes tracing with specified options, setting up directories and starting HAR tracer if needed.

methods.name: startChunk
methods.description: Begins a new trace chunk, setting up trace files and event listeners.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops tracing, finalizes trace files, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: stopChunk
methods.description: Stops the current trace chunk, optionally archiving or discarding it, and returns trace artifacts or entries.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Disposes snapshotter and stops HAR tracer.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes all pending trace data and resources.

methods.name: deleteTmpTracesDir
methods.description: Removes temporary traces directory if created.

methods.name: resetForReuse
methods.description: Resets the tracer for reuse, stopping current trace and resetting snapshotter.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Creates a new trace group with a specified name and location.

methods.name: groupEnd
methods.description: Ends the current trace group.

methods.name: _captureSnapshot
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of a given SDK object if conditions are met.

methods.name: onBeforeCall
methods.description: Handles pre-call event, logs trace event, and captures snapshot.

methods.name: onBeforeInputAction
methods.description: Handles pre-input action event, logs trace event, and captures snapshot.

methods.name: onCallLog
methods.description: Logs API call messages into trace.

methods.name: onAfterCall
methods.description: Handles post-call event, logs trace event, and captures snapshot.

methods.name: onEntryStarted
methods.description: Marks HAR entry as started.

methods.name: onEntryFinished
methods.description: Marks HAR entry as finished and logs resource snapshot.

methods.name: flushHarEntries
methods.description: Flushes all pending HAR entries into trace.

methods.name: onContentBlob
methods.description: Handles content blob resource.

methods.name: onSnapshotterBlob
methods.description: Handles snapshotter blob resource.

methods.name: onFrameSnapshot
methods.description: Logs frame snapshot event.

methods.name: _appendTraceEvent
methods.description: Appends a trace event to trace file, with optional flushing.

methods.name: _appendResource
methods.description: Stores resource buffer if not already stored.
